summary.label: snm_phase000_depth_quantize_repeated

comparisons.name: depth_quantize_320x240

baseline.label: Std build
baseline.checksum_policy: FNV-style checksum over quantized bin and angle degrees scaled by 1000
baseline.timer_boundary: computeDepthNormalQuantizedCandidate, depth millimeter conversion plus 8-neighbor normal solve and angle quantize
baseline.gate: organized PointXYZ cloud, width>=12, height>=12, finite z values become uint16 depth; non-finite depth becomes zero
baseline.mask: depth<2000 predicate plus abs(neighbor-depth)<50 bilateral predicate; border pixels are left zero
baseline.reduction: RVV per-lane 8-neighbor integer accumulation for det/ddx/ddy; scalar per-lane sqrt/atan2/angle quantize keeps Phase 000 exactness
baseline.asm_boundary: computeDepthNormalQuantizedCandidate / inlined RVV depth and neighbor accumulation in bench_snm_rvv
